defaults.source: Original study specification section 9.5; explicit independent completion version
defaults.rationale: Private local contention handling. No change to A/B selection, physical model, sensing, predictor or safety bounds.

parameters.name: r5_enabled
parameters.rationale: Separate version enabling local contention handling; never a third candidate in the frozen A/B comparison.

parameters.name: r5_front_margin_m
parameters.rationale: Predeclared geometric front-priority margin; equality remains ambiguous, with no label tie-break.

parameters.name: r5_visible_inward_speed_mps
parameters.rationale: Strictly greater measured inward inertial lateral speed is a conservative cue; independent m/s threshold, not hidden intent.

parameters.name: r5_yield_deceleration_mps2
parameters.rationale: Additional yielding request magnitude; actual final request still uses inherited longitudinal and swept safety checks.

parameters.name: r5_backoff_min_s
parameters.rationale: Lower endpoint of one private draw per persistent ambiguous episode; sealed before vehicle experiments.

parameters.name: r5_backoff_max_s
parameters.rationale: Exclusive upper endpoint of the same private draw; different deadlines may share a behavior tick.

parameters.name: r5_clear_stable_s
parameters.rationale: Consecutive visible no-competition duration before clearing an episode; missing time is not confirmation.
